human_response:
B — Apply one minimal contract clarification before acceptance.

Preserve the complete six-file mappings, 16 HarnessTask fields, 19-interface
count, and all existing review corrections.

Change only these contract decisions:

1. HarnessTaskGraphValidator returns the existing project-local

   packet preparer. Exact parsing and validation cases are deferred to Stage 2.

   coverage, and documentation-block preservation. It does not claim that a
   mapped transformation is semantically correct or human-accepted. Exact
   comparison algorithms and hardening tests are deferred to Stage 2.

4. ResourcePath uses the already accepted harness path contract. Exhaustive
   schema fixtures and rejection tests are deferred to Stage 2.

The version-1 generated-page drift is accepted as a separate legacy limitation
and does not block Stage 1. Do not repair or synchronize it here.

This is a contract-text correction only. Do not alter the mappings, add
interfaces, run another independent review, implement JSON behavior, or activate
Stage 2. Return directly for renewed human acceptance.
